entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, you're speaking with Charlie. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this helmet I bought. Just process it. Order number is VF-8675309.

I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up your order. Okay, I see the Aero-Core Helmet here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference? The color is completely wrong! I ordered 'Obsidian Black' and this thing is a faded charcoal gray. It's hideous. I'm not wearing it. This is your company's fault, not my 'preference'.
I understand your frustration completely. An incorrect color is definitely not the experience we want for our customers.

You bet it's not! The box is still unopened. I took one look at it and knew it was wrong. This should be simple. Are you going to give me my money back or do I need to speak to your manager and light up your social media pages?
There's no need for that, sir. I can definitely resolve this for you. Let me just check the delivery date to confirm the return eligibility. Please hold one moment.
Hurry up. This is a waste of my time. I'm a VIP member, you know. I expect better service.

Yes, I see your VIP status right here, and we truly appreciate your loyalty. Okay, I've got it. The helmet was delivered 21 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund.
Well, obviously. It should have been that easy from the start. So, what now?

I'm generating a prepaid return label and I've just sent it to the email on your account. And listen, for the inconvenience with the wrong color and the frustrating experience, I've gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your account. We want to make sure you get the gear that's right for you, and your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities.
Oh. A $50 credit? That's... fine. That's more like it. I appreciate you fixing this.
Of course. We're happy to do it. The refund will be processed as soon as the unopened box is scanned at the shipping center. Will there be anything else today?
No, that's all. Just make sure that label gets to me.
It's already in your inbox. Thank you again for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
